name: Tanaka Kokoa
source:
Rino's junior who joined the gymnastics club for the impure reason that she is popular with men. She is a good friend of Rino and they often discuss love stories. She is a fun-loving person, and basically just goes with the flow. She has a boyfriend, but she is open-minded about her sexuality and engages in paid dating. She's a slutty bitch who will fuck anyone as long as she can enjoy it!

[From [url=https://miconisomi.xii.jp/summer/]Miconisomi[/url]]
